tracks.delta: C=2000 not promoted (1.09x at 16b (13.3 vs 12.1 rel/s), 0.39x at 20b (1.5 vs 3.8 rel/s), 1.00x at 32b (0.0 vs 0.0 rel/s))

criteria.name: relation_rate_gain
criteria.target: >= 1.5x advantage over baseline across >= 3 adjacent sizes
criteria.justification: Advantage reversed or collapsed to 0 relations at [32]b.

criteria.name: scaling_persistence
criteria.target: Advantage persists with increasing bit length
criteria.justification: Complete yield drop-off to 0 relations observed at [32]b.

findings: Track A evaluated across 3 bit lengths (16-32 bits).
Observed scaling ratios: 1.09x at 16b (13.3 vs 12.1 rel/s), 0.39x at 20b (1.5 vs 3.8 rel/s), 1.00x at 32b (0.0 vs 0.0 rel/s).
Sharp relation-yield collapse observed at [32]b with 0 smooth relations found.
tracks.recommendation: Map the relation collapse boundary via a parametric grid over (factor_base_size x scale_c x candidate_budget) before attempting larger moduli.

tracks.delta: Cubic base-m shows genuine B1 signal; B3 relation yield not yet evaluated for promotion

criteria.name: b1_log_norm_advantage
criteria.justification: Degree-3 base-m representation consistently achieved <= 0.85 coefficient log-norm across all tested moduli.

criteria.name: b3_downstream_yield_promotion
criteria.target: >= 25% smooth relation yield improvement in B3 homogeneous sieve (rule: never promote on B1 alone)
criteria.observed: 423 pairs sampled; smooth relations and B3 relation rate not evaluated for promotion
criteria.justification: Per frozen protocol docs/06_TRACK_B_ALGEBRAIC_EVOLUTION.md: 'The director never promotes on Level B1 alone.' Downstream B3 yield was not evaluated.

findings: Multi-fidelity cascade B0-B3 verified algebraic representations across 32-64 bit moduli.
Degree-3 base-m representation measured log-norms: 23.80 (32b), 34.99 (48b), 46.06 (64b) vs deg-2 baseline: 30.68 (32b), 46.79 (48b), 61.97 (64b).
Promotion to E2 requires measuring actual smooth-relation yield in homogeneous sieving, which remains unevaluated.
tracks.recommendation: Execute B3 homogeneous sieving on top cubic candidates to measure actual smooth-relation rate through 64 bits.

tracks.delta: Exact rational Sturm/LLL verified at 32b; 40b/48b bound transition incomplete (1/3 recovered)

criteria.name: 50pct_msb_recovery_rate
criteria.target: 100% exact recovery at 50% known MSB across pilot ladder
criteria.justification: Exact Sturm/LLL small-root solver succeeded on 1/3 instances at 50% MSB.

criteria.name: calibration_ladder_completeness
criteria.observed: Only [0.5] tested with valid data; negative control used synthetic placeholder
criteria.justification: Genuine calibration surface requires testing true partial factor bit slices across 25%, 35%, 40%, 45%, 50%, 55%, 60%.

findings: Exact rational Sturm chain root isolation operates with zero IEEE-754 precision loss and recovers exact factors with no fallback.
Observed 50% MSB success rate was 1/3 (32b: SUCCESS (0.13s), 40b: FAIL, 48b: FAIL).
Negative control at 25% used a synthetic placeholder rather than genuine factor MSBs.
tracks.recommendation: Construct a multi-fraction calibration corpus (25% to 60%) to empirically map the exact univariate root recovery boundary.

tracks.delta: Schoolbook SAT baseline characterized; alternative carry-save encoding ready for comparison

criteria.name: baseline_characterization
criteria.target: Establish clean empirical solve-time scaling curve for Schoolbook SAT
criteria.justification: Clean, reproducible CDCL SAT scaling curve established across 5 consecutive bit lengths with zero semantic errors.

criteria.name: comparative_encoding_advantage
criteria.target: >= 2.0x solve time improvement over schoolbook across >= 3 adjacent sizes
criteria.observed: No alternative encoding evaluated in pilot run (schoolbook-only)
criteria.justification: Promotion requires comparing an alternative arithmetic encoding (e.g. carry-save adder tree) against the schoolbook baseline.

findings: Schoolbook SAT encoding successfully inverted across 16-32 bits with 100% factor recovery.
Empirical CDCL solve time exhibits clean scaling (0.0012s (16b) to 0.2195s (32b)).
Track D is not promoted because no paired alternative encoding was tested in this feasibility pilot.
tracks.recommendation: Implement carry-save adder tree encoding and execute the first paired encoding-vs-encoding scaling comparison.

proposals.hypothesis: Systematic grid over (factor_base_size x scale_c x candidate_budget) maps the relation collapse boundary on 20-32 bit moduli.
proposals.mechanism: Babai nearest plane relation yield collapsed at 32b; expanding factor base (25-40) and candidate budget (2000) tests whether relation yield recovers.
proposals.expected_effect: relation_discovery_rate > 0 at 32-bit and >= 1.5x gain over baseline
proposals.stopping_rule: stop if 2000 candidates yield 0 relations across all grid points
proposals.novelty_reason: Targeted calibration of relation collapse boundary revealed by PromotionJudge.

proposals.hypothesis: B3 homogeneous sieving on cubic candidates yields >= 25% smooth relations over quadratic base-m on 32-64 bits.
proposals.mechanism: Cubic representation verified in B1 log-norm; Level B3 evaluates true downstream algebraic-sieve relation rate.
proposals.stopping_rule: stop if B3 smooth relation yield is zero after 1000 pairs
proposals.novelty_reason: Evaluating downstream B3 smooth yield per frozen protocol requirement.

proposals.hypothesis: Fine-grained MSB calibration ladder (25%, 35%, 40%, 45%, 50%, 55%, 60%) establishes exact empirical recovery boundary.
proposals.mechanism: Testing genuine partial bit slices across 7 steps determines exact recovery cutoff and lattice dimension scaling limits.
proposals.expected_effect: empirical_recovery_curve mapped across all 7 fractions without synthetic placeholders
proposals.stopping_rule: stop if LLL basis reduction exceeds 60 seconds
proposals.novelty_reason: Full-ladder calibration replacing synthetic negative control.

proposals.hypothesis: Carry-save adder tree encoding reduces CDCL SAT solve time by >= 2x over schoolbook baseline on 24-32 bit moduli.
proposals.mechanism: Carry-save tree reduces clause dependency chain depth from O(n^2) to O(n log n).
proposals.stopping_rule: stop if D-CANARY-1 semantic equivalence test fails
proposals.novelty_reason: First paired encoding comparison against characterized schoolbook baseline.
